Around it: a radio console, record-store bins, theater lights, arcade cabinets, and mall signage layered like magazine collage fragments. Character proportions are slightly exaggerated with comic line work and watercolor textures. The year marker "1978" is integrated into the central architecture, while teaser boxes orbit the main illustration like classic print cover callouts.
